fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Brayton Topping Cycle + HRSG Thermal ODE
source: Moran, Shapiro, Boettner & Bailey (2018), Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics, 9th ed., Wiley (Ch. 9 gas turbine / Brayton cycle); Cengel & BoghosM.A. Boles (2015), Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach, 8th ed.; EPA CHP Catalog (2017); Kehlhofer et al. (2009), Combined-Cycle Gas & Steam Turbine Power Plants, 3rd ed., PennWell.

unit.name: Generic 5 MW Gas Turbine CHP — Brayton topping cycle + single-pressure HRSG

pressure_ratio.note: Compressor pressure ratio rp = P2/P1 (typical industrial GT ~12-18)

T_turbine_inlet_k.note: Turbine inlet temperature TIT (firing temperature ~1227 degC, modern industrial GT)

gamma_air.note: Air specific heat ratio cp/cv (cold-air-standard, Moran Table A-20)

gamma_gas.note: Combustion-gas specific heat ratio (hot section, Moran/Cengel hot-gas value)

cp_air.note: Air specific heat at constant pressure, ~300 K (Moran Table A-20: 1.005 kJ/kg.K)

cp_gas.note: Combustion-gas cp, hot section ~900-1200 K (Cengel: 1.147 kJ/kg.K)

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas (methane-rich, ~50 MJ/kg)

mdot_air_kgs.note: Air mass flow through compressor/turbine at full load

T_stack_k.note: HRSG stack outlet (exhaust to atmosphere) temperature, acid dew-point limit ~150 degC

T_water_in_k.note: Feedwater / heat-sink return temperature into HRSG (~105 degC)

hrsg_effectiveness.note: HRSG gas-side heat-recovery effectiveness (epsilon, fraction of available exhaust enthalpy above stack T captured)

m_hrsg_kg.note: Lumped HRSG metal + water thermal mass

UA_hrsg_wk.note: Overall gas->HRSG-mass conductance (UA) for lumped transient

PLR_min.note: Minimum part-load ratio for stable combustion
